items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Only three left. The others all practically died out. That's Ewan Wilson and Wilson.

ctx.x: Do you have any members in this young Excelsior band that were also in the old Excelsior band?

Me? The fellow played Triney. He played with them. And I think they had three or four was in there. But we were only three. Only three left. The others all practically died out. That's Ewan Wilson and Wilson. And this boy played, Buster played with him several times. But he wasn't, he was young, young, young, young, young, but you couldn't even, you know, count him. Because you couldn't even put him in there. But we got him playing plus nine. But he's just about as good as them as playing the old Excelsior at…
Oh yeah, Crank Bay. Yeah. Crank, something like that.
